question: In which of the following states did Prime Minister Narendra Modi unveil the Statue of Peace in November 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __Rajasthan. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__

 
• Prime Minister Narendra Modi unveiled the Statue of Peace on 16 November 2020. 
 
• The unveiling was done in order to mark the 151st birth anniversary of Shree Vijay Vallabh Surishwer Ji Maharaj. PM Modi did the unveiling via video conference.
